command:
set -euo pipefail
sudo kubectl delete serviceaccount,rolebinding audit-capacity-probe
sudo kubectl get --raw=/readyz
sudo kubectl get management -o wide
sudo kubectl -n kcm-system get backupstoragelocations -o wide
sudo kubectl get pods -A -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;x=json.load(sys.stdin)["items"];bad=[p["metadata"]["name"] for p in x if p["status"]["phase"]!="Succeeded" and not all(c.get("ready",False) for c in p["status"].get("containerStatuses",[{}]))];print("not_ready",bad);assert not bad'
POD=$(sudo kubectl -n kof get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kof-collectors-daemon-collector -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
sudo kubectl get --raw "/api/v1/namespaces/kof/pods/$POD:8888/proxy/metrics" | python3 -c 'import sys;ls=[l for l in sys.stdin if not l.startswith("#")]; print("".join(l for l in ls if "process_memory_rss" in l or "exporter_queue_size" in l or "send_failed_log_records" in l)); assert all(float(l.rsplit(" ",1)[1])==0 for l in ls if "send_failed_log_records" in l)'
